visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + audio player + tags + date + image

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 columns: cell 1 = H2 'Listen to the Latest TechPod', Wistia link (e.g. https://fast.wistia.com/embed/medias/6v8ipehwxr, text = episode title), paragraph of tag links (/blog/tag/...), paragraph date; cell 2 = episode image. JS replaces the Wistia link with <wistia-player media-id> (fast.wistia.com/player.js loaded lazily, near the viewport or on click); fallback = plain link.
